== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. The whole of the 2018 E card and the whole of the D-E1 card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
